notes: §2002:13.16.38.3 GR1 applied to record entries under an OUTPUT CD (§2002:A.1.2.2 SR9): Under an OUTPUT CD record (§2002:A.1.2.2 SR9) PIC N(3) defines three national character positions: LENGTH(NA)=3, NA(2:2)=N"BC" counts national positions, BYTE-LENGTH 6 under the implementor's UTF-16 national representation (two bytes a position); PIC X(3) defines three alphanumeric positions: LENGTH 3, BYTE-LENGTH 3. The --std 2002 run of the pinned build (dc1f2dcce8) matched the derived .out.
